faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about how Nura helps you navigate your healthcare journey.

items.question: What is Nura?
items.answer: Nura is a patient companion that helps you understand consultations, prescriptions, lab reports, and follow-up visits after leaving the doctor's office.

items.question: Is Nura a replacement for a doctor?
items.answer: No. Nura helps you understand your healthcare information. Always follow the advice of your healthcare professional.

items.question: Does Nura diagnose illnesses?
items.answer: No. Nura does not provide medical diagnoses. It explains information from consultations and medical documents in simple language.

items.question: Can I upload my lab reports?
items.answer: Yes. Upload supported laboratory reports to receive simpler explanations, highlighted findings, and reference ranges.

items.question: How does the follow-up visit work?
items.answer: During a follow-up visit, Nura helps you review your recovery, organize symptoms, prepare questions, and track your healthcare journey.

items.question: Is my medical information private?
items.answer: Yes. Your health information is stored securely and used only to provide the features you choose to use.

items.question: Which medical documents are supported?
items.answer: Nura currently supports consultation summaries, prescriptions, and common laboratory reports. More document types may be supported in future versions.

items.question: Can I access previous consultations?
items.answer: Yes. The Health Timeline shows previous consultations, prescriptions, lab reports, and follow-up visits in chronological order.
